posts.text: Yesterday was my final day as Director of National Intelligence. It’s time you know the truth. Go to ODNI.gov to see for yourself.

posts.text: On this Memorial Day, my heart feels heavy as I remember my brothers and sisters I served with who never made it home. We honor their ultimate sacrifice by standing up for the principles that unite us as Americans, defending our God-given freedoms, treating one another with aloha—respecting each other as children of God—and always striving for peace. Never forget. 🇺🇸
